Draw observed-data MFRM resamples

Source: R/api-resampling.R
draw_mfrm_resamples.Rd

Draw observed-data MFRM resamples

Usage

draw_mfrm_resamples(spec, keep_data = TRUE)

Arguments

spec

Output from build_mfrm_resampling_spec().

keep_data

Logical; if TRUE, return a list of replicate data frames. If FALSE, return manifest tables only.

Value

An object of class mfrm_resamples with:

  • samples: replicate data frames with original Person, draw-unit, stratum and top-up metadata, or an empty list when keep_data = FALSE.

  • manifest: replicate seeds, sampling scheme, base/added/final cluster counts, original Person counts, rating-row counts and coverage checks.

  • stratum_manifest: BasePersonClusters before top-up, TopupPersonClusters, final SelectedPersonClusters and SelectedOriginalPersons, and final Rows for each stratum.

  • preserve_manifest: observed coverage of requested facet levels.

  • spec and terminology: inputs, sampling assumptions and interpretation. summary() retains full manifests as well as compact tables. For older results with top-up, pre-top-up stratum counts are retained as base counts; unrecorded final cluster counts are NA, with a note, while final row counts remain available. This does not redraw old samples.

Details

See build_mfrm_resampling_spec() for sampling assumptions, top-up, label handling and saved-specification compatibility. Sampling keeps each selected Person's entire rating cluster and re-keys every instance when drawing with replacement. Other facet labels are retained.

See also

build_mfrm_resampling_spec()

Examples

# Same-size Person-cluster bootstrap within the observed Group strata.
ratings <- load_mfrmr_data("example_operational")
spec <- build_mfrm_resampling_spec(
  ratings, person = "Person", facets = c("Rater", "Criterion"),
  score = "Score", strata = "Group", reps = 2,
  design = "stratified_bootstrap", sample_fraction = 1,
  topup_preserve_facets = FALSE, seed = 99
)
draws <- draw_mfrm_resamples(spec, keep_data = FALSE)
summary(draws)$overview
#>                 Design              SamplingScheme Reps SamplesReturned Replace
#> 1 stratified_bootstrap stratified_person_bootstrap    2               0    TRUE
#>   PreserveCoverageCompleteRate TopupReps GapOrFallbackReps
#> 1                            1         0                 0
